rune.hextale.fire_water.effect: Turns water into steam and pushes with it.
rune.hextale.fire_water.use: Mechanism: a steam drive that moves pistons without redstone.
rune.hextale.fire_earth.use: Pickaxe: ore drops as ingots, sand as glass.
rune.hextale.fire_earth.hint: Heat aimed at ore gives ingots by itself.
rune.hextale.fire_air.effect: Blows a cone of flame ahead.
rune.hextale.fire_air.use: Gauntlets: a jet of fire 5 blocks long.
rune.hextale.fire_light.effect: A fire that shines and never dies without fuel.
rune.hextale.fire_light.use: Mechanism: a lantern without fuel that lights the lanterns next to it.
rune.hextale.fire_light.hint: A flame that shines without wood, forever.
rune.hextale.fire_shadow.effect: Burns only the creatures of darkness.
rune.hextale.fire_shadow.use: Sword: double damage to the undead, burns cobwebs.
rune.hextale.fire_life.effect: Sets the living on fire at a touch.
rune.hextale.fire_life.use: Weapon: sets the target on fire on hit.
rune.hextale.fire_metal.effect: Melts an item back into metal.
rune.hextale.fire_metal.use: Mechanism: a smelter that returns ingots from broken tools.
rune.hextale.fire_spark.effect: Releases all the heat at once, like a blast.
rune.hextale.fire_spark.use: Drill: blasts the 3×3 blocks around the point of impact.
rune.hextale.fire_spark.hint: All the heat at once. Dangerous.
rune.hextale.water_fire.effect: Puts out fire, cools lava into stone.
rune.hextale.water_fire.use: Staff: puts out fires around, lava turns to obsidian.
rune.hextale.water_fire.hint: Water douses fire and cools lava.
rune.hextale.water_earth.use: Shovel: sand, gravel and dirt go in whole layers.
rune.hextale.water_air.use: Device: a cloud in which mobs lose their target.
rune.hextale.water_light.effect: Gathers light like a drop of water.
rune.hextale.water_light.use: Spyglass monocle: zooms in and highlights distant targets.
rune.hextale.water_shadow.use: Trap: mobs get stuck and slowly sink.
rune.hextale.water_life.use: Staff: heals creatures and players around.
rune.hextale.water_life.hint: Water washes wounds. Turn it on the living.
rune.hextale.water_metal.use: Weapon: ruins enemy armour, takes apart other people's mechanisms.
rune.hextale.water_spark.use: Mechanism: carries energy along a water channel.
rune.hextale.earth_fire.effect: Makes a thing harder and resistant to heat.
rune.hextale.earth_fire.use: Any tool: loses durability half as fast, does not burn in lava.
rune.hextale.earth_fire.hint: Stone does not fear fire. Could a tool?
rune.hextale.earth_water.use: Device: seals water and lava behind a wall.
rune.hextale.earth_water.hint: A wall of earth holds back even lava.
rune.hextale.earth_air.effect: Pulls everything that flies down to the ground.
rune.hextale.earth_air.use: Weapon: knocks down flying mobs, cancels knockback.
rune.hextale.earth_light.use: Pickaxe: a chance to get a gem or a hextech shard.
rune.hextale.earth_shadow.use: Mechanism: a hidden chest that looks like any other block.
rune.hextale.earth_life.use: Hoe: farmland never dries out, crops grow faster.
rune.hextale.earth_spark.effect: Leads excess charge into the ground.
rune.hextale.earth_spark.use: Mechanism: a lightning rod that protects machines from overload.
rune.hextale.air_fire.use: Mechanism: bellows, furnaces and smelters work twice as fast.
rune.hextale.air_water.use: Mechanism: a pump that drains and moves water and lava.
rune.hextale.air_water.hint: Wind drives the waves. Could it drive water?
rune.hextale.air_earth.use: Mechanism: a rune piston that moves up to 12 blocks.
rune.hextale.air_earth.hint: A gust moves dust. Why not a whole block?
rune.hextale.air_light.use: Device: an illusion that mobs attack.
rune.hextale.air_shadow.use: Boots: neither mobs nor sculk can hear the player.
rune.hextale.air_life.use: Helmet: breathing underwater, an air bubble.
rune.hextale.air_metal.use: Mechanism: a lift and a crane for blocks and entities.
rune.hextale.air_spark.effect: Catches the wind and turns it into charge.
rune.hextale.air_spark.use: Mechanism: a wind generator, stronger up high.
rune.hextale.air_spark.hint: Catch the wind and make it a charge.
rune.hextale.light_fire.effect: Gathers heat into a thin beam.
rune.hextale.light_fire.use: Cutter: cuts blocks along a line, a long-range shot.
rune.hextale.light_water.use: Flask: removes poisons and negative effects.
rune.hextale.light_earth.use: Goggles: ores and caves show through walls.
rune.hextale.light_earth.hint: Light sent into stone shows what hides.
rune.hextale.light_air.effect: Casts a beam into the sky.
rune.hextale.light_air.use: Beacon marker: seen from afar, links devices together.
rune.hextale.light_shadow.use: Device: hostile mobs do not spawn around it.
rune.hextale.light_life.use: Lamp: crops grow underground and at night.
rune.hextale.light_metal.use: Workbench: transfers runes onto tools and parts.
rune.hextale.light_spark.use: Mechanism: a light panel that works by day.
rune.hextale.shadow_fire.use: Mechanism: cools overheated machines, puts furnaces out.
rune.hextale.shadow_water.use: Device: drains water and lava around it.
rune.hextale.shadow_earth.effect: Makes stone passable for a moment.
rune.hextale.shadow_earth.use: Gauntlets: walk through a wall up to 2 blocks thick.
rune.hextale.shadow_air.hint: Shadow spilled into the air hides anyone.
rune.hextale.shadow_light.use: Device: darkness around it, torches go out.
rune.hextale.shadow_life.use: Weapon: part of the damage heals the wielder.
rune.hextale.shadow_metal.use: Weapon: enemy armour and tools break quickly.
rune.hextale.shadow_spark.use: Device: shuts down mechanisms around it.
rune.hextale.life_fire.use: Armour: immunity to fire and lava for a while.
rune.hextale.life_earth.effect: Grows things out of the soil.
rune.hextale.life_earth.use: Staff: trees and crops grow at once.
rune.hextale.life_earth.hint: Life from the soil: sprouts in a heartbeat.
rune.hextale.life_air.use: Mechanism: plants seeds around by itself.
rune.hextale.life_light.use: Arrows: highlight the target through walls.
rune.hextale.life_shadow.use: Weapon: passive and weak mobs fall asleep.
rune.hextale.life_metal.effect: Heals the lifeless as if it were alive.
rune.hextale.life_metal.hint: Life heals flesh. Could it mend steel?
rune.hextale.metal_fire.use: Mechanism: a rune furnace and smelter.
rune.hextale.metal_earth.hint: A chisel that bites into stone.
rune.hextale.metal_air.use: Mechanism: a fan that blows entities and items away.
rune.hextale.metal_shadow.use: Device: chests and doors open only with a rune key.
rune.hextale.metal_life.effect: Gives metal a semblance of life.
rune.hextale.metal_spark.use: Mechanism: an engine for every machine.
rune.hextale.metal_spark.hint: In metal, a charge starts turning wheels.
rune.hextale.spark_water.use: Trap: damages everyone in the water.
rune.hextale.spark_earth.effect: Strikes the ground with a discharge.
rune.hextale.spark_earth.use: Hammer: stuns everything around and crushes stone.
rune.hextale.spark_air.effect: Sends a discharge through the air.
rune.hextale.spark_air.hint: Lightning leaps from target to target.
rune.hextale.spark_shadow.effect: Carries you through the shadow on a discharge.
rune.hextale.spark_shadow.use: Gauntlets: a teleporting dash of 8 blocks.
rune.hextale.spark_metal.use: Mechanism: collects dropped items and ore.
rune.hextale.spark_metal.hint: Lightning loves iron. Let it pull iron.

gui.hextale.research_table.choose: Choose a rune in the book
gui.hextale.research_table.slot.paper: Paper: every research starts on a fresh sheet
item.hextale.rune_scroll.too_early: Too early: %s is not open to you in the research book yet.
gui.hextale.research_table.ink.hint: Drawn from Essence Tanks of %s concentrate around the table
item.hextale.essence_flask.mixture.hint: A mixture: split it with a reagent in a Separator
gui.hextale.alembic.cold: Needs heat below: fire, a lit campfire, lava or magma
gui.hextale.separator.mix: Mixture: comes in through the inlets, or from a bottle
gui.hextale.separator.extract: Concentrate of the reagent's essence: leaves through the concentrate outlets
gui.hextale.alembic.out: Leaves through the spout at the front, or into glass bottles
gui.hextale.separator.rest: The rest of the mixture: leaves through the rest outlets
gui.hextale.separator.no_reagent.hint: The reagent decides which essence goes into the concentrate
gui.hextale.slot.bottles: Glass bottles: the essence is bottled into them
gui.hextale.slot.alembic.input: An item to boil into essence. An unstudied one gives dark unknown essence
gui.hextale.slot.alembic.output: A filled bottle of essence comes out here
gui.hextale.slot.separator.pour: A bottle of mixture to pour in
gui.hextale.slot.separator.reagent: A reagent: charcoal - fire, sugar - water, clay - earth, feather - air, glow ink sac - light, ink sac - shadow, bone meal - life, iron nugget - metal, redstone - lightning
gui.hextale.slot.separator.extract: The bottled concentrate comes out here
gui.hextale.slot.separator.rest: The bottled rest of the mixture comes out here
gui.hextale.research_table.ink.no_storag: No storage: place an Essence Tank of %s concentrate next to the table
gui.hextale.separator.ports.hint: The separator seen from above, its front towards you. Click a side to choose what its pipe does - or sneak-use that side of the block.
gui.hextale.port.inlet.hint: A pipe here brings the mixture in (green, arrow in)
gui.hextale.port.product.hint: The wanted product leaves here (blue, arrow out)
gui.hextale.port.waste.hint: The by-product leaves here (rust, stopcock, arrow out)
gui.hextale.port.none.hint: Nothing goes in or out here; no pipe joins it
gui.hextale.separator.vent.hint: The top lets out the gas of separation
item.hextale.essence_flask.unknown.hint: Unknown essence: the dark by-product of separation. It is no ink; pour it away through a Drain Valve
block.hextale.drain_valve.open: Valve open: what the pipes bring pours out
gui.hextale.alembic.water.hint: Each item boils in %s mB. Pipe water in from a Pump at the back or the sides, or pour a water bucket on the alembic
jei.hextale.boiling.heat: Heat under the alembic: fire, a lit campfire, lava or magma
jei.hextale.boiling.result: A mixture of the item's essences - study the item at the Research Table to know them
jei.hextale.info.alembic: Boils items into essence: studied ones into a mixture of their essences, unstudied ones into dark unknown essence. Set it over heat (fire, a lit campfire, lava or magma) and give it water: a bucket by hand or a pipe from a pump at the back or the sides. Every item takes 250 mB. The essence is poured into glass bottles or leaves through the spout at the front.
jei.hextale.info.separator: Splits a mixture in two with a reagent: the reagent's essence becomes a concentrate, the rest goes on with a dark unknown essence added. Choose in its screen - or by sneak-using a side - which side takes the mixture in and which lets the concentrate or the rest out. The top is a gas vent.
jei.hextale.info.essence_tank: Stores 256 mB of essence. Pipes fill it at the top and the sides, it lets out at the bottom, and Separator inlets draw from it. Tanks of concentrate within two blocks of a Research Table are its ink.
jei.hextale.info.brass_pipe: Carries essence and water between machines. It joins a machine only where the machine has a port; the machine shows the joint.
jei.hextale.info.pump: Place it in water: it pumps water up into a pipe on its top.
jei.hextale.info.drain_valve: Use it to open or shut the handwheel. Open, it pours out whatever the pipes at its sides bring.
jei.hextale.info.research_table: Keeps no ink of its own: it draws each essence's ink from Essence Tanks of that concentrate within two blocks of the desk.
jei.hextale.info.essence_flask: A glass bottle of essence. A bottle of a single essence is a concentrate - the Research Table's ink. A mixture is split in a Separator; what is left is an unknown essence.
book.hextale.quest.scheme.essence_flask: a bottle in the alembic's slot
commands.hextale.quests.reset: Reset the Researcher's Path quests of %s
quest.hextale.research_table.desc: Items and runes are studied here. The table is two blocks wide. The "Research book" tab picks a rune, the "Desk" tab is where the work happens: diary, hextech, paper and the parchment.
quest.hextale.brass.desc: An alloy of copper and gold. Every tool of the researcher is made of brass: the table, pipes, tanks, the alembic and the separator. An ingot splits into nine nuggets and back.
quest.hextale.unstable_hextech.desc: Put a lightning rod on an amethyst block and wait for a storm: the lightning shatters the amethyst into hextech orbs. A Channeling trident calls the lightning too. Every rune you research takes one orb.
quest.hextale.researchers_diary.desc: This is the book you are reading (right click). Put it on the table - no research happens without it. The diary is signed with the name of whoever opens it first. Knowledge stays with you, not in the diary.
quest.hextale.item_study.desc: Put an item into the study slot and paper into the paper slot. Click the parchment: a ripple stops at the nearest hidden essence, and glowing sections hint where it is. Find every essence and the item is studied. The first strike takes the item and a paper.
quest.hextale.essences.desc: Every item holds essences - fire, water, earth, air, light, shadow, life, metal and lightning - of different strength. A studied item shows them in its tooltip. Essences become rune ink; an unstudied item boils only into dark unknown essence.
quest.hextale.alembic.desc: Boils items in water into a mixture of their essences. An unstudied item gives only dark unknown essence. It needs fire, a lit campfire, lava or magma underneath. Every item takes 250 mB of water: pour a bucket in or pipe it from a pump.
quest.hextale.brass_pipe.desc: Carry essence and water between machines. A pipe joins a machine only at a port - a joint appears there.
quest.hextale.pump.desc: Place the pump in a water source - it pumps water up into a pipe. No more buckets for the alembic.
quest.hextale.essence_bottle.desc: Put glass bottles into the alembic - it fills them with the boiled mixture, 16 mB each. Bottles carry essence between machines by hand. A mixture is not ink yet: it holds all the item's essences at once.
quest.hextale.separator.desc: Splits a mixture in two. The reagent picks an essence: it becomes a concentrate, everything else goes to the rest with a dark unknown essence. Choose what each side does - inlet, concentrate or rest - on the separator's screen or by sneak-using that side.
quest.hextale.drain_valve.desc: The separator's rest is not ink. Pipe it to the valve and open the handwheel: whatever arrives pours out.
quest.hextale.concentrate.desc: A concentrate is one pure essence - this is the ink. The reagent decides which essence the separator draws out (hover an item).
quest.hextale.essence_tank.desc: Holds 256 mB. Takes essence in at the top and the sides, lets it out at the bottom. Use a bottle on the tank to pour or fill. Sneak-use a side with an empty hand to stick an essence label on it; every click changes the sign.
quest.hextale.ink.goal: open the table with a tank of concentrate nearby
quest.hextale.ink.desc: The table draws ink by itself from tanks of concentrate within two blocks. Runes need different essences - keep a tank of each. The supply shows on the "Desk" tab.
quest.hextale.rune_research.desc: Pick a rune on the star map and send it to the table. Draw ink with the mouse from the orb to every point: a new line may start at the orb or at any inked section. A step spends the ink of the essence whose corner it heads to, a step onto a point 10 mB of that point's own essence. Right click takes a step back. The shorter the drawing, the more stars.
quest.hextale.first_rune.desc: Use the scroll (right click) to learn the rune - the scroll is spent. Smelting opens the other runes of chapter I.
quest.hextale.three_stars.goal: learn a rune with three stars
quest.hextale.three_stars.desc: Stars depend on the length of the whole drawing: the shortest gives three. Branch your lines instead of drawing them twice. A rune can be researched again - the best stars stay.
quest.hextale.first_signs.desc: Chapter I is Smelting and the five runes around it. Four learned runes open chapter II: the essence rays of the star map.
quest.hextale.craft.desc: From chapter II on, the ink may cross dark runes, but some of them are cursed. An inked section next to them shows how many curses touch it - like a minesweeper. Right-click a dark rune to flag it. A mistake bursts the orb. Ten runes of chapter II open chapter III.
quest.hextale.depths.goal: learn a rune of chapter III
quest.hextale.depths.desc: Chapter III has more curses, and its points hide inside rings of dark runes. Curses found are remembered on the parchment.
quest.hextale.full_codex.desc: Every star of the map is yours.
goggles.hextale.network: In the vessels on this network:
quest.hextale.researchers_goggles.desc: Wear them on your head. Looking at a tank, a pipe or a machine shows the essences inside. Looking at a Research Table shows its ink, and coloured streams run from the tanks to the orb.
research.hextale.burst: A cursed dark rune! The orb burst, the sheet burnt and the ink is spent. The curse is marked on the parchment of %s.
item.hextale.hextech_tool.no_runes: No runes yet: engrave them at a Hextech Altar
block.hextale.hextech_altar.empty: Put an item on the altar first
block.hextale.hextech_altar.nothing: The circle does not know what to do with this: check the pedestals, steles and tanks
block.hextale.hextech_altar.busy: A ritual is running - sneak + use to abort it (what was drawn is lost)
block.hextale.hextech_altar.hint: Item in hand: put it on the altar. Sneak + empty hand: start the ritual
gui.hextale.stele.subtitle: Choose a rune for the circle
gui.hextale.stele.unknown: A rune you have not learned yet
gui.hextale.stele.choose: Click: set it on the stele
book.hextale.quest.infusion.missing: The altar recipe is not loaded
quest.hextale.hextech_altar.desc: The heart of the ritual circle. Items, essences and runes around it become something new. Sneak + empty hand starts a ritual.
quest.hextale.pedestal.desc: Set them up to 6 blocks from the altar and put the ritual's items on them - as many as the ritual needs. Nothing extra may lie around.
quest.hextale.rune_stele.desc: Choose one of your runes on it. Within 7 blocks of the altar its rune directs the ritual: engraving, devices.
quest.hextale.hextech_pickaxe.goal: infuse an iron pickaxe at the altar
quest.hextale.hextech_pickaxe.desc: Essence Tanks within 8 blocks feed the altar. The pickaxe keeps its enchantments and gets three rune slots and an essence cell.
quest.hextale.first_engraving.goal: engrave a rune into a hextech tool
quest.hextale.first_engraving.desc: Hextech tool on the altar, a rune on a stele, the right items on the pedestals - which ones, you find out. A tool takes up to four runes.
quest.hextale.charged_tool.goal: charge a hextech tool at the altar
quest.hextale.charged_tool.desc: A tool with runes alone on the altar fills its cell from the tanks with the essences its runes burn.
jei.hextale.info.hextech_altar: The heart of the ritual circle. Put the centre item on it, the ritual's items on pedestals within 6 blocks, choose runes on rune steles within 7 blocks; Essence Tanks within 8 blocks feed it. Sneak + empty hand (or a redstone pulse) starts the ritual. A hextech tool alone on it is charged with the essences its runes burn.
jei.hextale.info.pedestal: Holds one item of an altar ritual. Up to 6 blocks from the altar, one block up or down; any number of them. Hoppers can fill it.
jei.hextale.info.rune_stele: Choose one of the runes you know on it. Within 7 blocks of a Hextech Altar it directs the ritual; steles are read clockwise from north.
quest.hextale.hextech_bricks.desc: Deepslate bricks with amethyst veins grown through them: the stone of the ritual circle. Two slabs stacked make chiseled bricks with a crystal set in.
block.hextale.hextech_altar.wait.item: The ritual waits: put %s back on its pedestal
